purpose: Rules by which Python pre-diagnosis and R feature preparation both interpret raw archive records, before applying their own stage-specific scope.
shared_rules: Location identifiers are text; "01" and "1" are different locations.
Rows with a missing or blank location are removed (single-location mode assigns the configured location instead).

Reference and report dates are the calendar date written at the start of the value (YYYY-MM-DD); a following time of day or UTC offset, as in 2024-12-06T00:00:00Z, is ignored, never converted. Anything else is an invalid date.
The effective as-of date is the given as_of_date, otherwise the latest valid report date; rows reported after it are removed.
Values must be usable numbers; a numerator/denominator pair needs both, with a positive denominator.
Reporting lag is report_date - reference_date; negative lags are removed.
Lags beyond the stage's lag bound are removed; the global bound is lag_horizon_days.
Duplicate identity is (location, reference date, report date); among usable rows the last in file order is kept.
intentional_differences: Python pre-diagnosis examines lags through lag_horizon_days.
R feature preparation uses the feature horizon min(target_lag + 100, lag_horizon_days).
R feature preparation additionally applies the experiment window and the minimum location size.
